text: The 40-update, 1.5 mm accumulated-smoothing candidate passes native export, independent geometry, complete-cell topology and strict bidirectional anatomy improvement on both development sentinels. Brain round-trip maxima are about 0.098 and 0.094 mm. The 0.75 mm candidate also repairs geometry but retains a forward-HD95 tie on 11-to-12; that strict anatomy failure remains recorded. A sealed finer-smoothing follow-up is deferred before any fitting because the original panel already supplies an eligible candidate.
